scenes.text: This tutorial covers Timelapse. Segment, link, and measure cells or pathogens across the frames of a time series.
Open Timelapse from the Core section. Select a time-resolved image set whose filenames preserve field, time, depth, and channel indices.
In the main configuration area, configure segmentation, tracked object types, linking mode, maximum displacement, gap handling, and preview frames.
Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. validate tracks on representative motion before processing the entire time series.
When the workflow finishes, time-indexed masks, tracks, measurements, and trajectory summaries are stored with stable object identities.
